item.title: Eversholt Street, between Levertons and Oakley Square Gardens, 28th July
item.description:
The foliage in this part of the street has been overgrown for years. It's so low that pedestrians are forced to walk in the middle of the street only, as there are bike racks on the road side that make the street even narrower. I've witnessed blind people struggle to navigate this area, as well as people in wheelchairs / scooters, especially when people have been standing around in that space. Part of the fence appears to be buckling under the weight of the vegetation. Can Camden arrange for this to be dealt with.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 239, Eversholt Street, Fitzrovia, Greater London
